At a glance

Pros & cons

Aero 14

  • Gorgeous OLED panel

  • Fastest of the three

  • Lightest
  • Best battery life

Verdict

Best overall

Aero 14

The OLED screen, 18-hour battery and quiet design make it the best all-round daily driver. The 512 GB SSD is plenty for most people, and the weight keeps it comfortable in a bag all day.

Best for power users

Forge 16

If you need to render, game or run heavy workloads, the 16-core CPU and 32 GB of upgradeable RAM are hard to beat. You pay for it in weight, battery and price, but for a workstation it earns its keep.

Best value

Nimbus 13

At $999 with the longest battery and lightest body, it is the obvious pick for students or anyone who mostly browses, writes and takes notes. The 256 GB SSD is the main compromise—budget for an external drive.
